questions.badPrompt: Make an advertisement for a college fest.
questions.context: An upcoming 3-day inter-college technical and cultural festival.
missingElements: Target audience demographics (age, interest)
Tone and brand personality
Platform format (video script, Instagram reel, poster copy, radio spot)
Key attractions and call to action (registration link, dates)
Constraints (duration, character count, output structure)

questions.badPrompt: Write a story about an AI taking over a coffee shop.
missingElements: Main characters & protagonist perspective
Pacing and narrative arc (conflict, climax, resolution)
Humor style and dialogue format
Word limit and formatting specifications

questions.context: A premium noise-cancelling smart headphone designed for developers & remote workers.
missingElements: Product details and unique selling proposition (USP)
Ideal customer profile and pain points
Marketing framework (AIDA, PAS, Feature-Benefit)
Pricing tier, objection handling, and conversion CTA
Delivery format (landing page copy, cold email, sales pitch deck)

questions.badPrompt: Write a launch strategy for an app.
questions.context: A peer-to-peer campus ride-sharing and carpool app.
missingElements: Target geography and rollout phases (Beta vs Public)
User acquisition channels (guerrilla marketing, campus ambassadors)
Budget constraints and timeline breakdown
Key performance indicators (KPIs) and conversion goals

questions.context: Quarterly e-commerce revenue figures across 4 regions with sudden Q3 drop.
missingElements: Specific analytical goals (anomaly detection, MoM growth, profit margins)
Required statistical metrics and calculations
Output format (markdown summary table, executive bullet points, chart recommendations)
Target audience (board of directors vs operational managers)
Actionable recommendations based on insights

questions.context: Comparing Tesla Model 3 and Hyundai Ioniq 5 for fleet purchase.
missingElements: Comparison criteria (battery efficiency, TCO, maintenance, charging curve)
Evaluation methodology and scoring weightage
Structured comparison matrix/table
Executive recommendation with ROI justification

questions.context: Organizing a 24-hour hackathon with 500 participants on a tight budget.
missingElements: Event scope, theme, and timeline breakdown (T-minus milestones)
Budget limits, sponsorship strategy, and volunteer allocation
Risk mitigation & contingency plans (power outage, food, WiFi failure)
Judging criteria and participant deliverables
Structured master operational schedule

questions.context: Severe vehicle congestion and lack of two-wheeler slots during morning peak hours.
missingElements: Stakeholder analysis (students, faculty, administration)
Short-term fixes vs long-term infrastructural solutions
Enforcement and incentive mechanisms (digital passes, zoning)
Phased implementation roadmap and measurable success metrics
